text_block_list.text:
King Halo claimed victory in the Japanese 
Derby. Her triumphant laughter in the 
winner's circle was short-lived, however, 
as she slipped away from the press.

"...In order to divert the press's eyes 
away from Special Week, who was shedding 
tears of regret in defeat."

After the race, the phone rings. It's a 
call from King Halo's mother—praising 
Special Week's run, while scolding King 
Halo for how she acted after her victory.

...If they still won't acknowledge me, 
then so be it. King Halo swore to leave 
her mark in the final leg of the Classic 
Triple Crown, the Kikuka Sho.
